basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Founding AI Engineer & Cofounder CTO · Production Agentic Systems · 13y Investor (30.57% XIRR) · Algo Trader · MBA
basics.summary: Two lifelong strengths, one convergence: 13+ years shipping production AI, and 13+ years running a personal portfolio at 30.57% XIRR with algo trading in the remaining hours. The exact combination an AI-native trading operating system needs. At LumApps I built the AI Brain, a Graphiti and Neo4j temporal knowledge graph that unifies 5+ silos into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes, the shape needed to represent counterparties, flows and market context. Founded three AI companies on the side, including PulseView, an explainable AI market-intelligence agent shipped from my own trading portfolio first. Founding engineer DNA: zero to production, solo, before hiring.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Designed AI Brain, a Graphiti and Neo4j temporal knowledge graph that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest, per-agent query/write-back contracts, freshness layer. Same shape needed for counterparties, flows and market context.

Built production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over Vertex AI (ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation), tools over MCP, state streamed to UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2-3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast quarterly revenue.
Owned end to end: agent architecture, eval pipelines, tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request telemetry, on-call. Report to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; unit economics first, model choice second.
Architected Employee Referral System end to end as tech lead (reporting to CIO). Platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA. Co-owned GTM with Sales and PM.
Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales. Every feature shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle; killed the ones that did not.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production: infra, risk controls, and the engineering tradeoffs specific to live trading.
Evaluated 20+ fintech and AI startups on architecture, scalability and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform solo before hiring: full stack, cloud infra, real-time flight-control APIs, logistics optimization. 500+ real-world deliveries, 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built the cloud + CI/CD from scratch to enterprise-grade reliability. Enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase. Zero to live, ambiguity-friendly, physical-world messy.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Foundational applied ML (optimization under noise, search over huge state spaces, learning-from-environment loops), the primitives underneath modern agentic systems.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify signals from technical and news data. Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship. The template for an agentic layer that keeps a human in control of every priced decision.

projects.name: Personal Investing & Algorithmic Trading (13+ years)
projects.description: 13+ year track record as a private investor, 30.57% XIRR compounded through cycles. Systematic and algo trading in parallel: signal design, backtesting, execution automation, live risk and P&L monitoring. Where the reflex to check risk before size comes from.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent practice, home for the AI products I design, build and run solo (PulseView, SwissNRI, Proplab). Zero-to-production playbook: multi-agent systems, RAG grounding, eval pipelines and observability, shipped by one engineer with commercial ownership.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA/FEMA/Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation. Compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users act, the same posture required for flows that must be risk-checked before execution.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI-native operating layer for physical commodity trading, developed and proven through an integrated trading operation. Founded by a physical commodity trader with 15+ years across leading global trading houses, built with Merantix Capital. Building: trading cockpit, proprietary intelligence platform (counterparties, relationships, flows, market context), agentic layer, learning loop, workflow automation. Role: ship the first product yourself, take the platform from zero to live trading support solo before hiring, co-define company strategy with CEO, go into the field with traders, pitch investors, recruit and lead founding engineering team. Profile: strong math/ML/data engineering foundation, applied AI/ML depth shipped in messy real-world environments, heterogeneous unstructured data to decision systems (knowledge graphs, agentic systems, LLM orchestration, signal/time-series pipelines), commercially strong (P&L not just model metrics), strategic thinker, comfort with early-stage ambiguity. No commodities experience required, willingness to learn deeply and speak trader language is. Location: flexible with strong preference for co-working in Switzerland plus field time. Co-founder equity, cash calibrated to venture stage, funded start.
_jobApplication.notes: User is a 13+ year investor at 30.57% XIRR, does algo trading in parallel to AI day job, looking for the next adventure that connects AI and markets. Visionary CV + cover letter requested.
